notes.title: Lore n' Vania Update Released
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="iEoCEJkUvnE;full"][/previewyoutube][p] 
Changelog:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lore[/b] - Data logs and environmental storytelling! [i]The city maps, in particular, have received a lot of work.[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Vania[/b] - We've leaned more into the Metroidvania aspects of Relentless Frontier, adding more environmental interactivity with the player's weapons and abilities![/p][/*][*][p][b]The Pulverizer[/b] - A new bolt-action mine thrower! Launches sticky proximity mines that can latch onto the environment as a trap, or fired directly at the enemy to detonate on impact. Effective against armor and swarms, but the ammo is rare and expensive to omnistruct. Use 'em wisely! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Poison Pods[/b] - The bugs have started using chemical warfare! These armored, purple-glowing pods emit a potent corrosive gas, eating through armor and flesh alike in the blink of an eye. Direct damage doesn't seem to have an effect, but they seem to be extremely flammable... [/p][/*][*][p][b]An Actual Ending Sequence[/b] - You will no longer be dumped into a "YOURE WINNER" screen at the end of Episode 1! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved FX[/b] - Better gore, more destructibility, cooler hit feedback, and most importantly, etc! Lots and lots of etc. [/p][/*][*][p][b]UI / UX Improvements[/b] - Smoothing out the menus, and adding more options (Including a walk/run toggle!) [/p][/*][*][p][b]Bombardier Refinements[/b] - Everyone's favorite lump of literal (and metaphorical) bugginess is getting some much-needed attention! We want to emphasize his role as an artillery tank, and make him less frustrating to fight without fire damage. Maybe get him a new coat of FX work?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixes![/b] - Ideally, we've fixed everything! Realistically, we've fixed most things. But players [i]always[/i] find more things. If you do find a bug, feel free to shout at us on the Steam Forums, or join our [url="discord.gg/fp59DpxEkV"]Discord[/url] and shout at us there![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Relentless Frontier Update 0.5.0 Now Available
notes.notes:
Heyo! We've got a new major update for Relentless Frontier and a Soundtrack release, dropped just in time for the Steam Winter Sale! What a coincidence!

Update Changes include:
[list]
[*]New Score Attack Gamemode! Start fully-equipped with extra lives and DO BIG COMBO to watch that score sail and get those letter grade medallions!*
[*]Improved Shotgun Altfire! The electrodart affects more enemies, creates a huge electric explosion when it hits water, and can supercharge explosive barrels, launch flame canisters, and turn the electric barrel into an electric turret!
[*] A bunch of bugfixes and improvements!
[/list]

Also, take a look and a listen at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3236860/Relentless_Frontier_Soundtrack/]Relentless Frontier Soundtrack![/url] Good jams cooked-up by Malaphors and John S. Weekly (Primeval)! High quality FLACS and additional suite mixes are part of the deal!

Hope everyone enjoys the rest of their year!

notes.title: Relentless Frontier Update 0.4.2 Now Available
notes.notes:
Top of the [TIME UNIT] to ya. We've been toiling in the dev mines to drag up some raw IMPROVEMENTS to Relentless Frontier, and I think we've got some good stuff to show just before Boomstock! 

Main Changes:
[list]
[*] Level Select has been added! When you start a new game, you can either start up a campaign like normal, or go to Level Select and choose which level you would like to start on (as long as you've been to the level once before), as well as the difficulty.
[*] Menu Upgrade! We've done some work on the main menu, and laid down some framework for the extra game modes we have planned for the future.
[*] Aim Assist! We've implemented an enhanced aim assist (thanks Jay!). Can be toggled in the Gameplay settings, with adjustable pull strength.
[*] Finished optimization on all enemy sprites, which has lowered VRAM usage a bit more. Should result in better performance when a bunch of enemies are shooting and spitting and clawing and whatnot.
[*] A buncha small map changes and fixes!
[/list]

Next update, we'll be adding some new side areas to Episode 1, beefing up the story a bit, and adding the Score Attack gameplay mutator! (Score attack is fun as hell btw, can't wait to show it off).

As always, if you've got feedback or questions, let us know!

notes.title: Confirmation of Release Date: July 24th
notes.notes:
This is a just a quick message confirming that the release date for Relentless Frontier early access is [b]July 24th[/b]. We announced the shifting of the date over a week ago, but very cleverly forgot to mention it on Steam. 

The reason for the delay is the usual stuff, we found a few (non flammable) bugs that were serious enough to warrant another week of polish and testing to make sure Relentless Frontier is fit for release. And the good news is that it is! The issues found have been fixed and we're very much in the final stages of being ready to share this with you all. There will be a proper release day new post with all the juicy details so I'll leave it at that. 

On behalf of the Relentless Frontier team, 

Cheers,

BB

notes.title: Nextfest Demo 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
List of changes:
- Reworked tutorials on the first map, as well as some layout changes
- Reworked outdoor lighting and fade
- HUD icons for the omnifuel conversions now flash when your omnifuel is overflowed
- Health omnifuel icon flashes at low health if you have 10 or more omnifuel
- Finally replaced the placeholder "Game Over" message!

And a whole bunch of really minor things, bugfixes and balance changes, etc.

This should be the final demo update, as we're now focusing on finishing up the second half of Episode 1 for Early Access!

notes.title: Nextfest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody! We actually released this build a few weeks ago, but we kept it hush-hush until Nextfest started. Here's a truncated list of changes this build:

- New Enemy, the Missile Drone! They try to keep their distance and barrage the player with missiles. Just keep moving, and maybe try to lure some other enemies into the blast zone?
- New Weapon Upgrade, the Shredder Shot! An upgrade for the Peacekeeper Shotgun that gives it's pellets the ability to pierce soft targets and bounce off of the environment. Excellent for clearing hallways and caves!
- Newly remastered music by the powerful composer team Malaphors! 
- Improved drone enemy AI
- Improved enemy hit feedback, including impact sounds and more gore!
- Updated Omnifuel HUD
- Lots of optimization work
- A bunch of boring stuff that makes the game play better, I promise!

Give it a go, and let us know what it was like! We're always looking for feedback, and we love hearing about how your playthroughs went.

Korzodin
